defect_observations: 040 body 497-499: the remark says that with one individual 'every type has one member, so 26^alpha holds at every type'. With one individual D_o still has two members, and 26^o fails in every standard model (thm p02-w02-p02-040-church-soundness clause 4). The remark holds only for alpha = iota, iota', iota'', .... Correctness note.

Church 1940 §7 p. 67 says the proofs of 31 and 32 are possible only for types alpha with a proof of 30^alpha. The route states 31-32 under that hypothesis but does not reproduce the 'only' restriction (040 body 504-528). With Axiom 11 present, 31 and 32 appear derivable from 33 alone, so the restriction may hold only relative to Axiom 9. Correctness note; not counted as a coverage gap.
